Composition of one comparison: subtype shares and composition-driven DE

Source: R/plotComposition.R
plotComposition.Rd

Two panels for a comparison whose cluster has a finer annotation nested in it (see assessComposition()). Left: each subtype's share of the cluster's cells per sample, by condition; a shift here makes the subtypes' markers look DE in the cluster's pseudobulk. Right: per gene, the observed log2 fold change of the cluster's own DE test against the change the subtype shift alone predicts. Genes the test calls DE are coloured by their attribution; genes on the diagonal are explained by composition.

Usage

plotComposition(res, comparison, nLabel = 10)

Arguments

res

The result of assessAll() run with two nested annotation levels.

comparison

A comparison key from res$comparison.

nLabel

Number of composition-driven genes to label, largest observed change first. Default 10.

Value

A patchwork of two ggplots.
